title: Farwa ki Hasratou ka Aata Hai Ran se Lasha
body:
Farwa ki hasratou ka aata hai ran se lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaimou me shah e deen ke ek hasr sa hai barpa
1. Shiddat ki tashnagi me josh e wega dekhayi
Terah baras ke sin me kya khoob ki ladhayi
Ladta bhi kab talak woh tha teen din ka pyasa......
<<MINI>>
Farwa ki hasratou ka aata hai ran se lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ayi sada e Qasim jald aayiye chacha jaan
Gurze sitam se ab mai girta hu suwe maidaan
Pamaal horaha hoon dum toothta hai mera.....
<<MINI>>
Farwa ki hasratou ka aata hai ran se lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tege ajal chala ker pohanche jo shah ran mein
Nousha e Karbala toh bikhra huwa tha ban mein
Yeh haal dekhker ab dil gham se phatraha tha......
<<MINI>>
Farwa ki hasratou ka aata hai ran se lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Mahool o qatl o khoon me shadi ajeeb dekhi
They teen din ke bhuke pyaase sabhi baraati aur huzlay e aaroosi matam sara bana tha......
<<MINI>>
Farwa ki hasratou ka aata hai ran se lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Allah kya ghazab hai lamhou ki ek dulhan per
Baithi hai oudhker woh bewaa si ek chadar
Chaya huwa hai gham se dulhan pe ek saktaa.....
<<MINI>>
Farwa ki hasratou ka aata hai ran se lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Roodad e gham dulhan ab kisse bayaan karegi
Saidaniyou me uske uske humsin nahi hai koi
Ghut ghut ke roorahiu hai sar ko jhukaye kubra.....
<<MINI>>
Farwa ki hasratou ka aata hai ran se lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aaye hai sub barati kapde siyaah pehney
Shaadi ki jaa pa logou jaata hai koi aise
Kyun kar sohail ab yeh barpa hai shor e giryaa.....
<<MINI>>
Farwa ki hasratou ka aata hai ran se lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz..Raza Ali sohail
